about: The AP Precalculus app pages. scripts/build-apprecalc.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in precalculus/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApPrecalcCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apprecalc-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the ten trainers of docs/apprecalc-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page precalculus/tools/<slug>.html, script precalculus/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model precalculus/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApPrecalcMath.<camelSlug>), content precalculus/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/apprecalc-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/apprecalc-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/apprecalc-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. FREE OR PREMIUM is set here and only here: a tool with "premium": "tools" is Premium; function-lab, rate-of-change and unit-circle carry none and are free (docs/apprecalc-spec.md section 6, proposed; owner to confirm).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Precalculus practice by unit, topic or skill: graphs and tables in stimulus sets, typed expressions graded by value, calculator and no-calculator questions.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a mathematical practice, with graph and table sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your precalculus spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed precalculus unit tests and full practice exams in the May 2027 format: 29 + 13 multiple-choice, then the four free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the May 2027 four-part format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Precalculus free-response practice in the four exam types, 6 points each, with a point-by-point rubric, a full-credit sample and a printable answer sheet.
apps.card: All four free-response types, with 6-point rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Make it specific
apps.desc: Precalculus answers made specific enough to score: reasons tied to the given values, limit notation, secant slopes, concavity and the domain a context allows.
apps.lede: Write the answer, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: Reasons tied to the given values, limit notation and rate wording, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Precalculus cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with timed mixed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition precalculus flashcards built from the glossary, by unit and topic.

apps.title: Trainers
apps.desc: Precalculus trainers: function lab, rates of change, rational functions, exponentials and logs, regression, unit circle, sinusoids, Q4 steps and polar graphs.
apps.card: Trainers and drills, then the questions about what you did.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your precalculus mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every precalculus lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For precalculus teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and sharing pages to Google Classroom, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Function lab
tools.title: Function Lab
tools.desc: Every function type on one stage: drag the parameters and watch the graph, table, formula and words change together, with zeros, asymptotes and end behavior.
tools.blurb: Drag the parameters; graph, table and formula move together.
tools.lede: Drag a parameter and watch every representation change at once.

tools.name: Rate of change
tools.title: Rate of Change
tools.desc: Average rates of change as secant slopes over equal intervals, how those rates change, concavity, and the reasoning the modeling question asks for.
tools.blurb: Secant slopes over equal intervals, and what concavity says.
tools.lede: See average rates as secant slopes, then read concavity from them.

tools.name: Polynomials and rationals
tools.title: Polynomials and Rational Functions
tools.desc: Zeros and multiplicity, end behavior in limit notation, holes, vertical and horizontal asymptotes and sign charts, built from the factored form.
tools.blurb: Zeros, holes, asymptotes and end behavior from the factors.
tools.lede: Build a polynomial or rational function factor by factor.

tools.name: Exponential and log lab
tools.title: Exponential and Log Lab
tools.desc: Exponential growth against linear growth (ratios against differences), logarithms as inverses, the log rules on a graph, and semi-log plots.
tools.blurb: Ratios versus differences, logs as inverses, semi-log plots.
tools.lede: Compare equal ratios with equal differences, then undo them with logs.

tools.name: Regression lab
tools.title: Regression Lab
tools.desc: Fit linear, quadratic, cubic, exponential, logarithmic and sinusoidal models to data, read residual plots, choose a model and answer to three decimals.
tools.blurb: Fit a model, read the residuals, give three decimals.
tools.lede: Fit a model to the data and let the residuals tell you if it fits.

tools.name: Unit circle
tools.title: Unit Circle
tools.desc: Radians as arc length, sine and cosine as coordinates on the circle, tangent as a slope, and the sine and cosine graphs unrolling as the angle turns.
tools.blurb: Sine, cosine and tangent from the circle, and the graphs unrolling.
tools.lede: Turn the angle and watch sine and cosine unroll into their graphs.

tools.name: Sinusoid builder
tools.title: Sinusoid Builder
tools.desc: Periodic models from data or a context: amplitude, period and b, phase shift and midline, with the five key points of one cycle.
tools.blurb: Amplitude, period, phase shift and midline from a context.
tools.lede: Build a sinusoid from its highs, lows and one cycle.

tools.name: Symbolic steps
tools.title: Symbolic Steps
tools.desc: Rewriting and solving step by step: a single logarithm, a single trigonometric term, equations quadratic in e to the x, and inverse trig with the right range.
tools.blurb: Q4 rewriting and solving, each step graded by value.
tools.lede: Rewrite and solve one step at a time, each step checked by value.

tools.name: Polar graphs
tools.title: Polar Graphs
tools.desc: Polar coordinates and curves drawn as the angle sweeps, linked to the graph of r against the angle, and how the distance from the origin changes.
tools.blurb: Curves drawn as the angle sweeps, linked to r against the angle.
tools.lede: Sweep the angle and watch the polar curve draw itself.

tools.name: Vectors and matrices
tools.title: Vectors and Matrices
tools.desc: Parametric motion, vectors and their sums, and 2 by 2 matrices as transformations of the plane. Beyond the exam: Unit 4 is not tested.
tools.blurb: Parametric motion, vectors and matrices as transformations.
tools.lede: Move a point with parameters, then transform the plane with a matrix.
